name: Circa Survive
label: Equal Vision Records
lede: Anthony Green quit Saosin because he was scared, then built a band in Philadelphia around effects-drenched guitars and that voice. It lasted eighteen years, through a major-label detour, a stay in a mental health facility and a relapse.

eras.title: Scared out of Saosin
eras.text: Green quit Saosin in mid-February 2004, before the band's first album. He went home to the Philadelphia area and, with Equal Vision Records behind him, had a new band built from friends in the local post-hardcore circuit within months.

years.big: I was just scared. I was scared of committing.
years.src: Wikipedia: Circa Survive · Wikipedia: Anthony Green
years.h: Anthony Green leaves Saosin before the first album
years.p: In mid-February 2004 Green, 21, walks away from Saosin and Cove Reber takes his place. Green's words, from Wikipedia: "the big thing was that I was just scared."
years.xp:
Green went back to Philadelphia and called his friend Colin Frangicetto, and the two started recording and recruiting.

He would not sing with Saosin again for ten years. In February 2014 the band announced he would rejoin for the Skate and Surf festival that May, and he stayed on for the 2016 album Along the Shadow while keeping Circa Survive and his solo work going.

years.h: Philadelphia friends fill out the line-up by summer
years.p: Frangicetto brings guitarist Brendan Ekstrom from his old band [[This Day Forward|bcd7a1a3-ab7e-40cd-b604-d5197f3fc598]]; bassist Nick Beard comes from Taken, and Steve Clifford takes the drums.
years.xp:
Equal Vision backed the new band from the start and helped with the recruiting. Ekstrom and Frangicetto had toured with Taken in their This Day Forward days, which is how they knew Beard.

Clifford came through Vadim Taver of Marigold. Frangicetto remembered that Clifford jammed with them for a week and that was it.

years.h: The debut album gets announced on MySpace
years.p: In November 2004 Circa Survive post the news of Juturna there, and later stream the whole record on the site before it's in stores.

eras.title: Montauk and the Twilight Army
eras.text: Juturna borrowed from a novel and a Kaufman film, and two years on the road with My Chemical Romance, Thrice and Coheed and Cambria carried the band to On Letting Go and a No. 24 debut.

years.h: Juturna reaches No. 183 on the Billboard 200
years.p: Brian McTernan produces at Salad Days in Beltsville, Maryland. The album draws on the novel House of Leaves and the film Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind.
years.xp:
The closer, Meet Me in Montauk, is named for a line in Eternal Sunshine and carries a hidden track, House of Leaves, starting at 8:56. The album runs 11 tracks and 52 minutes, 33 seconds.

Two guitars drenched in effects sit over drums borrowed from jazz. AllMusic gave it 2.5 stars out of 5 and filed it under progressive hardcore; AbsolutePunk scored it 80%.

years.h: Opening for My Chemical Romance and Thrice within months
years.p: A September tour with [[Motion City Soundtrack|190e78ac-8f44-4bf1-a4ff-95ed9376ad9e]] follows, all on the strength of Juturna.

years.cap: Circa Survive back at The Bamboozle, May 4, 2008
years.h: Green wears a dress to The Bamboozle
years.p: Green often wears dresses at outdoor festivals, including The Bamboozle in New Jersey in 2006 and the 2007 Warped Tour.

years.h: The first headline tour is called the Twilight Army
years.p: It follows a European run with Coheed and Cambria and Thrice. That fall Circa Survive go out with [[Thursday|0acae232-d31a-4211-b6d0-6af1b6350274]], [[Rise Against|606bf117-494f-4864-891f-09d63ff6aa4b]] and [[Billy Talent|fd429857-5ace-4609-ae54-1502c3bdac11]].

years.h: Coachella in April, then the whole summer on Warped Tour
years.p: The Indio, California festival comes first; the summer's Warped Tour follows alongside Coheed and Cambria, [[The Used|8262d8e4-9137-4bb3-a787-3caabbbc13e9]] and [[Bad Religion|149e6720-4e4a-41a4-afca-6d29083fc091]].

years.h: 24,000 copies in a week put On Letting Go at No. 24
years.p: Brian McTernan produces again, and Esao Andrews paints the cover.
years.xp:
The second Equal Vision album came out with tighter guitars and drums and more bass in the mix. By July 11, 2007 it had sold 51,357 copies, per Wikipedia.

On the tour, the band projected a silent film behind them while they played.

years.h: Brixton Academy with Thirty Seconds to Mars, New Year's in Jersey
years.p: On September 14 Circa Survive support [[Thirty Seconds to Mars|d8354b38-e942-4c89-ba93-29323432abc3]] in London, then ring in 2008 at the Starland Ballroom with Thursday and [[The Gaslight Anthem|f208f09e-b5b3-4b06-87cd-f7230fae17e3]].

eras.title: A major label, and a hospital stay
eras.text: Circa Survive moved to Atlantic Records, and Green's voluntary stay in a mental health facility fed their highest-charting album. It didn't sell enough to keep the label interested.

years.h: A charity B-side helps Siren Records move
years.p: The Most Dangerous Commercials is a download for Siren, the record store in Green's hometown of Doylestown. That spring, 1,000 Witnesses raised money for Invisible Children.

years.h: Green's first solo album, Avalon, reaches No. 44
years.p: It comes out August 5, 2008, the first of several solo records he makes alongside the band.
years.xp: Green put out Avalon while Circa Survive were still touring On Letting Go. It peaked at No. 44 on the Billboard 200.

years.cap: Circa Survive at Revolution Live, Fort Lauderdale, April 25, 2010
years.src: Wikipedia: Circa Survive · Wikipedia: Anthony Green
years.h: Blue Sky Noise goes to No. 11, their highest peak
years.p: Made in Toronto with producer [[David Bottrill|1f2f08f6-487d-4bcc-8f9b-41c170b2464f]]. Many of the lyrics come from Green's voluntary three-week stay in a mental health facility.
years.xp:
Wikipedia describes Blue Sky Noise as based on Green's struggles with mental illness. Green has bipolar disorder, which was earlier misdiagnosed as schizophrenia, according to Wikipedia. He has also spent years fighting alcohol and heroin addiction.

[[Rich Costey|d7e7825f-cb30-4c56-a7c8-e0fae10f93f8]] mixed the record, finishing on February 1, 2010. Pre-orders came with a digital copy a week early and the single Get Out.

years.cap: Circa Survive at the Pac Sun Beach Ballyhoo, Santa Monica, June 19, 2010
years.h: Too many people show up, so the Ballyhoo set ends early
years.p: Circa Survive's set at the Pac Sun Beach Ballyhoo in Santa Monica is cut short on June 19, 2010 because of overcrowding.

years.h: 43,000 viewers watch the London show online
years.p: On a European run with Middle Class Rut, the September 15, 2010 London show streams to more than 43,000 people.

years.h: Leftovers become Appendage, with a Nirvana cover on the side
years.p: Five songs including Stare Like You'll Stay and Lazarus. A MySpace live EP in October adds [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]]'s Scentless Apprentice, and the band open two shows for [[Linkin Park|f59c5520-5f46-4d2c-b2c4-822eabf53419]].

eras.title: Paying for it themselves
eras.text: When Atlantic offered less for the next album, Circa Survive left and paid for Violent Waves themselves. Sumerian released Descensus, Hopeless released The Amulet, and a Manila festival put them on a bill with Cannibal Corpse.

years.h: Atlantic offers less, so Circa Survive pay for Violent Waves themselves
years.p: Green said in 2020 that the money shrank after Blue Sky Noise missed sales targets. Recording started April 16, 2012.

years.h: 33 headline dates after the My Chemical Romance tour
years.p: The World Contamination Tour's North American leg with My Chemical Romance and Architects comes first. The headline run has [[Balance and Composure|0d20c42d-133c-429d-8f76-3c2458aee3e8]], [[O'Brother|c6740ace-804e-4d40-aba0-e9c7bfe2cdd2]] and [[Touché Amoré|ea367e3c-4c74-460b-8a99-bbbb9b1ad5cf]].

years.h: Manila's Pulp Summer Slam puts them beside Cannibal Corpse
years.p: The April 27, 2013 bill also has [[DragonForce|ef58d4c9-0d40-42ba-bfab-9186c1483edd]], [[Cannibal Corpse|af8e4cc5-ef54-458d-a194-7b210acf638f]], Coheed and Cambria and [[As I Lay Dying|ba147ea0-60c4-4a40-9da6-0d5c2b2e7b03]].

years.h: The Shrine Expo Hall show gets filmed for a DVD
years.p: The December 28, 2013 Los Angeles show is recorded for a DVD packed with the 2014 Violent Waves reissue.

years.h: Record Store Day split with Sunny Day Real Estate
years.p: Circa Survive's side of the single is Bad Heart; [[Sunny Day Real Estate|86b24e8f-a4d9-4c84-83ee-fde0d14ad9fa]] are the Seattle emo band.

years.cap: Circa Survive at the Great South Bay Music Festival, Patchogue, New York, July 18, 2014
q: the most aggressive Circa record we've ever made
years.h: Descensus is cut in Conshohocken with Will Yip
years.p: Eleven songs on Sumerian, tracked with producer [[Will Yip|282e2957-fd09-4260-babf-50f1d57eeb75]] in spring 2014.
years.xp: Sessions ran from mid-April to the end of May at Studio 4 in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania. Esao Andrews painted the cover again.

years.cap: Circa Survive at the Shrine, Los Angeles, February 24, 2017
years.h: On Letting Go turns ten, with mewithoutYou and Turnover
years.p: Circa Survive play the album on an anniversary tour. The Los Angeles stop is the Shrine on February 24, 2017.

years.h: A sixth album, The Amulet, on Hopeless Records
years.p: Announced July 10 with Lustration. That fall Circa Survive co-headline with [[Thrice|244afcb7-fa9a-49b1-9aa6-0149512d1c52]].
years.xp: It is the third label in three records: self-released Violent Waves, Sumerian for Descensus, now Hopeless.

eras.title: Two dreams, then silence
eras.text: Green went public about a relapse in 2019. The last new music was two EPs that leaned electronic, and in October 2022 they stopped.

years.h: Green tells Twitter he has relapsed
years.p: On November 10, 2019 he writes that he is "trying to take time to pull myself back together" and calls it the hardest thing he and his family had faced.
years.xp: Green had earlier written publicly about years of fighting alcohol and heroin addiction.

years.h: A Dream About Love pushes them toward electronics
years.p: Out October 22 with Imposter Syndrome, the first of two EPs.

years.h: The companion EP, A Dream About Death, with Electric Moose
years.p: Green also joins the supergroup [[L.S. Dunes|5bd58bb8-7afc-4664-9b7e-77a687e00137]] with [[Frank Iero|358db9a2-3c78-4afb-93b5-d18b34b86eab]] this year.
years.xp: L.S. Dunes was announced on August 26, 2022, with Iero, Travis Stever of Coheed and Cambria and members of Thursday. Its debut, Past Lives, came out that year.

years.h: Circa Survive cancel their tour and go on hiatus
years.p: They call it an indefinite hiatus and say their future is uncertain. In December they combine the two EPs into the album Two Dreams.

eras.title: It was a breakup, until it wasn't
eras.text: Three years into the hiatus, Green said what fans suspected. Two months later the band was on a festival poster.

years.h: Green says the hiatus was a breakup
years.p: In December 2025 he admits Circa Survive had broken up, and that it stemmed from his relapse in 2022.

years.h: Louder Than Life puts Circa Survive on its poster
years.p: The Louisville festival announces them for September, alongside [[Iron Maiden|ca891d65-d9b0-4258-89f7-e6ba29d83767]], My Chemical Romance, [[Tool|66fc5bf8-daa4-4241-b378-9bc9077939d2]] and [[Chiodos|b755836a-0cb6-4577-a678-55a5a6402d70]].

years.h: Circa Survive come back, in Louisville and Philadelphia
years.p: On September 19, 2026 they play Louder Than Life in Kentucky. A fan clip shows a September 15 show in their hometown, their first there in almost five years.
